cohort: A cohort of 278 pregnant women was monitored at multiple intervals from 6-10 weeks to 32-36 weeks of gestation.
finding: Preterm delivery is characterized by significantly higher maternal sFlt1 levels and uterine artery resistance in the third trimester, and an altered relationship between sFlt1 concentrations and uterine artery RI compared to term deliveries.
gest_age: Pregnant women monitored from 6-10 weeks up to 32-36 weeks of gestation; preterm delivery defined as birth before 37 weeks.
